identifier.value: Digital Sales Tools for Real Estate Developers

product.name: Digital Sales Tools for Real Estate Developers
product.description: A software platform that displays real estate inventory on a map synchronized with CRM data, enabling sales teams to manage availability and sales processes digitally.

product.name: One-Click Offer Generation
product.description: A feature that allows instant creation of customer offers for properties, eliminating manual compilation and speeding up the sales process.

product.name: Real-Time Inventory Synchronization
product.description: A service that synchronizes property inventory data with developers' systems to ensure up-to-date availability information for sales teams and customers.

product.name: Online Payment Enablement
product.description: A feature that allows sales teams to accept reservations and payments for property units from local and international clients through the platform.

product.name: Multi-Project Management Plans
product.description: Pricing plans and service tiers that accommodate real estate developers managing single or multiple projects with varying inventory sizes and feature needs.
